about_the_game:
Blast off into the infinite universe!
"Rocket Penguin" is a unique 2D flying game that may seem simple but requires master-level skills to reach outer space.

As a bird that cannot fly, the penguin protagonist Peeo has always envied those who can soar freely through the sky. One day, by a twist of fate, he acquires a unique rocket engine and, henceforth, embarks on a bizarre adventure!

  • A quirky rocket flight – just two buttons, and it actually works!

  • Endless altitude expedition mode: strive to break through the atmosphere, challenge the world rankings, or test your limits!

  • Every crash brings you closer to mastering the art of flight.

  • 20+ story levels filled with unique challenges, from eating contests and speed races to cargo delivery and even soccer matches!

  • Customize your look and upgrade your rocket!

  • Meet penguins of all shapes and sizes!

  • Local split-screen PvP – battle your friends or crash into chaos together!


Collect all the rockets!

Each rocket comes with unique specs and abilities, with over 10 different rockets to pilot!


Meet the penguins!

Throughout your journey, you'll meet a variety of penguins. Who will be your trusty ally, and who will try to sabotage you?

Get ready for a bizarre rocket adventure — how high can you soar?
"Just one more time, I believe I can fly!"
